## What does milk coffee mean for an Indian kitchen?

In most Indian homes, milk coffee means a glass of hot milk stirred with a spoonful of instant powder and sugar — quick, comforting, and non-negotiable before the day starts. The milk carries the flavor, so the coffee underneath has to hold its ground without turning bitter or flat. A 70/30 blend like Ultra Blend (₹309 for 100g) is built for exactly this: the chicory adds body and cuts the sharpness so the cup stays smooth even when the milk ratio is high. If you prefer zero chicory, Bold (₹369 for 100g) brings a deeper, straight-coffee punch that still stands up to a heavy pour of milk. One concrete tip: dissolve the granules in a splash of hot water first, then top with steaming milk — you get a proper crema-like layer instead of clumps floating on top. Purity Beans keeps the ingredient list honest so you know exactly what hits the glass every morning.

### A plain definition

Whatever brought you here, the label settles it. The other single jars on this page are 0% chicory.

## How do you read the chicory line on the jar?

Flip the jar and find the ingredient list. If the first word is coffee, you are holding coffee. If it says chicory first, the jar is mostly filler. That is the whole trick. Some brands print a percentage in tiny type near the bottom. Others hide it behind a peel-back label or skip the number entirely and hope you will not ask. A clean label reads coffee and nothing else. Purity Beans prints the exact split on every jar. Bold, Purista, and Purica are pure coffee with zero chicory. No vague claims. No hidden lines. If you drink milk coffee daily, the percentage decides whether the coffee flavor survives the milk or disappears. Next time you shop, turn the jar over and read the first two ingredients out loud. If you cannot find a percentage in five seconds, put it back. You are not guessing anymore. Bold 50g is ₹239 and 100g is ₹369. Purista 50g is ₹319 and 100g is ₹509. Purica 50g is ₹329 and 100g is ₹559. Ultra Blend 50g is ₹209 and 100g is ₹309. The Variety Box gives you all four 50g jars for ₹877.

## Which jar suits the way you drink coffee?

When you brew a rich morning milk coffee at home, finding a jar that holds its character without losing its profile makes all the difference. If you prefer pure coffee without any chicory, Bold delivers a deep, full-bodied kick as an agglomerated instant coffee at ₹239 for 50g and ₹369 for 100g. For a gourmet touch, our freeze-dried options like Purista, featuring pure Robusta at ₹319 for 50g, and Purica, featuring pure Arabica at ₹329 for 50g, lock in rich aromas and natural crema. Purity Beans offers a variety of ways to enjoy your daily cup, whether you are trying a tasting flight with the 4 × 50g Variety Box for ₹877 or exploring the Gourmet Duo Mini pair at ₹570. When you are standing in your kitchen craving a proper cup of morning warmth, knowing what you are paying for matters. If you want to explore gourmet options, Purista Robusta freeze-dried granules cost ₹319 for 50g and ₹509 for 100g, while Purica Arabica freeze-dried granules are ₹329 for 50g and ₹559 for 100g. Orders above ₹399 qualify for free shipping right to your doorstep.

## How do people brew instant coffee in Indian cities?

In fast-paced urban apartments across Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Delhi, the morning ritual usually starts with the familiar hiss of milk heating on a stovetop. When people want a comforting morning mug of milk coffee, they typically spoon instant coffee powder straight into a mug, add a splash of warm milk to dissolve it smoothly, and then pour in the rest. The secret to a rich cup without complicated equipment lies in letting the granules melt gently before adding sugar. Purity Beans keeps this daily ritual straightforward, offering clear choices for every preference.

Walking down the coffee aisle can feel overwhelming when every jar boasts a grand slogan. Instead of relying on marketing phrases, turn the jar around and check the ingredients list first. If you prefer gourmet notes, freeze-dried granules like Purista and Purica deliver pure coffee with locked-in aromas. Purity Beans keeps every label transparent so you always know whether you are pouring pure coffee or a balanced blend into your mug.
